payload.claim: [host-filed criterion probe] tests/test_package.py::test_reverify_says_each_suites_line_through_emit_or_print stayed green with the spec's wrong version "The event's phase is `GATE`." applied to saffron/phases/package.py as an edit. The claim was "`reverify` takes an optional `emit`. Handed one, it hands each suite's line to that `emit` as a `PhaseStart` with phase `PACKAGE`, label `re-verify` and the spec's id, and prints nothing. Handed none, it prints each line, on every call. Each line reads `re-verify: baseline suite at <new_base_sha cut to 12>`, then `re-verify: head suite at <packaged_sha cut to 12>`, as at your base. The witness drives one call with an `emit` and two calls without one, with two distinct shas whose characters vary along their length, and compares every line whole.", and the whole `tests` gate stayed green under the edit too.
